summary: Several steps rest on undocumented definitional equality between submodule coercion norms (`(le_of_eq rfl)`, bare `exact h`, trailing `rfl` after `simp`/`push_cast`/`rw`), and setup steps are copy-pasted across the chart lemmas instead of factored out. Two proofs exceed 50 lines and have little structural commentary.
